inputs.description: a blacksmith hammer ringing on an anvil, three steady blows on hot iron, the metal ringing after
songbirds calling and answering in a sunlit wood, near and far, no wind
a light breeze rustling through leaves and tall grass in the open countryside, calm, no birds
a cat purring contentedly in its sleep, close by, slow and soft
the hush of a cool, empty stone chapel, a faint echo of distant air, very quiet
a small flock of hens clucking and scratching in straw inside a wooden coop, close by
a lone crow cawing twice, somewhere in the distance over open fields
the low roar of a fire burning in a blacksmith forge, a steady draught and crackle, no hammering
an old stone fountain trickling and splashing softly into its basin
a small fox kit whimpering weakly, tired and frightened, in the undergrowth
an unnatural, heavy stillness in a dark forest clearing, a faint low hum, no birds, no wind
glass bottles and jars clinking softly as they are moved on a wooden shelf
a small wood fire crackling gently in a cottage hearth, soft pops and hisses, warm and close
a startled hen squawking and flapping its wings in a wooden coop
summer insects humming and buzzing lazily over still water, dragonflies and gnats
a lightning strike very close by, a sharp crack of thunder that shakes the air and rolls away into the distance
a small black-iron clockwork mechanism whirring and ticking to itself, steady and faintly wrong
heavy rain beating on wooden shutters in the dark, a steady downpour, no thunder
a gentle river flowing slowly past reeds, soft lapping at a muddy bank
a small brass bell over a shop door jingling as the door opens and closes
a twig snapping underfoot somewhere in the undergrowth, then a short rustle of leaves
a quiet village square, a few hushed voices at market stalls and footsteps on cobblestones, no words can be made out
a single drop of water falling into a deep stone well, a small echoing plink
wind gusting and whistling softly
old wooden boards creaking slowly under strain, a single very slow groan of weathered timber
